statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-14662 (PostgreSQL tsvector and tsquery undersize allocations, via integer wraparound) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.15 on the 16 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-14662/ lists 16.15 as the fixed release for major version 16, the 16.15 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.15/, list this CVE, and the fix is commits https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/23d9ad771817c123ebdc16ebc65977754c82b5ab and https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/90649b6f846c7593f0f57b2b821b8d8eb1e18693 (changing the tsvector and tsquery code under src/backend/tsearch and src/backend/utils/adt, each tagged Security: CVE-2026-14662 and back-patched through 14). Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD on the 3.23-stable branch lists CVE-2026-14662 under its 16.15-r0 secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. The DHI postgresql16 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball and applies no security backports, and the postgres server binary in each published build reports its upstream release on both x86_64 and aarch64: 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0 report PostgreSQL 16.15 and 16.16 and carry the fix, while the earlier published builds 16.13-r0 and 16.14-r0 report 16.13 and 16.14 and are affected. 16.15-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.
